name: Extension popup
oneLiner: a glass browser on an ordinary page: the cursor clicks the brand's extension icon in the toolbar, its popup springs open under it while the page dims, the one action button is pressed, runs with a spinner and fill, and turns green with a result line
say: when the speaker introduces a browser extension or a one-click tool ('install the extension and hit this button', 'it works on any page'): the icon is clicked as they name it, the green done lands on 'and that's it' or 'done'
